hint: A percent is a number out of $100$, and the word of signals an operation. Rewrite the percent in a form you can calculate with.

hints.text: A percent is a number out of $100$, and the word of signals an operation. Rewrite the percent in a form you can calculate with.
Write $30\%$ as the decimal $0.30$ and multiply it by the whole amount: $0.30 \times 250$.
Since $0.30 \times 250 = 75$, the answer is that $30\%$ of $250$ is $75$.

learningObjective: Compute a percent of a number.
explanation: Change the percent into a decimal by dividing by $100$: $30\% = 0.30$.
A percent of a number means multiply, so work out $0.30 \times 250 = 75$.
As a check, $10\%$ of $250$ is $25$ and three of those make $75$. So $30\%$ of $250$ is $75$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Build percents from 10%
steps: Finding $10\%$ is just moving the decimal one place: $250 \to 25$.
From there, $30\%$ is three of those, $5\%$ is half of one, and $1\%$ is a tenth.
This decomposition handles most percent arithmetic mentally, faster than reaching for the calculator.
